Class BudgetCourseService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.BudgetCourseService
@Service public class BudgetCourseService extends Object
The one place that reads and writes budget_courses (issue #363): the quarter's single row per section, holding the enrollment estimate and the cached UCSB API figures that the TA and ULA recruitments share.

The cached figures are refreshed by whatever already fetches the quarter's offerings from the UCSB API (the Populate job, the Courses page's refresh on opening, Add by enroll code): no extra call is ever made for them. The Courses page's refresh is the one that is gated by the time to live: isFresh(String, Collection) says whether every figure the page would show was checked against the API within TTL, and the refresh skips the API when so.

    • attach

      public void attach(String quarter, RecruitmentCourse row)

    • ensure

      public BudgetCourse ensure(String quarter, RecruitmentCourse row)
      The row for a recruitment course's section, created (with the quarter's budget, if that is missing too) when there is none yet: the case when a recruitment first gets the section, or gets it back after removing it. A new row has no figures and no estimate until the next fetch or the admin's next entry.

    • cache

      public BudgetCourse cache(String quarter, RecruitmentCourse row, UcsbSection section)
      Caches one section's figures from the API's answer for it (Add by enroll code), creating the row if need be, and returns the row.

    • refreshCache

      public int refreshCache(String quarter, Collection<RecruitmentCourse> rows, Map<String, UcsbSection> sections)
      After a fetch of the whole quarter's offerings (Populate, or the Courses page's refresh): makes sure every given recruitment course has its row, re-caches the figures of every row of the quarter whose section the fetch found, and stamps every row of the quarter as checked now, found or not, so a section the API has dropped does not keep the quarter stale for ever. Returns how many rows got figures.
      Parameters:
      rows - the recruitment's rows the fetch applied to, which must have a row here
      sections - every primary section the fetch returned, by enroll code

    • isFresh

      public boolean isFresh(String quarter, Collection<RecruitmentCourse> rows)
      Whether every given recruitment course's figures were checked against the UCSB API within TTL, so a page opening need not call it. A row with no budget course row yet, or one never stamped, is not fresh. With no rows there is nothing to refresh, so they are fresh.

    • setEstimate

      public BudgetCourse setEstimate(String quarter, RecruitmentCourse row, Integer estimate)
      Sets (or with null clears) the section's one estimate for the quarter, as typed by the admin, so with no source; creates the row if need be. Returns the row.

    • fillEstimates

      public int fillEstimates(String quarter, Collection<RecruitmentCourse> rows, EnrollmentEstimateSource source)
      Copies the cached maximum (MAX) or current (ACTUAL) enrollment into the estimate of every given section that has that figure, recording the source; a section with no row or no figure keeps its estimate. Returns how many estimates were set.

    • dropIfUnused

      public boolean dropIfUnused(String quarter, String enrollCode)
      After a recruitment removed the section: deletes the quarter's row for it unless some recruitment of the quarter still has the section and has not removed it (decided by the maintainer: a section that comes back starts with an empty estimate). Returns whether the row was deleted.
